scenario:
Six documentary films — Fjord, Glacier, Harbor, Inlet, Jetty, and Kelp — will be screened one at a time at a film festival, each on a different one of six consecutive evenings: Monday through Saturday. Each film is screened exactly once. The following conditions apply:
1. Fjord is screened earlier in the week than Harbor.
2. Glacier is screened on Wednesday or Thursday.
3. Inlet is screened immediately before Jetty.
4. Kelp is not screened on Monday or Saturday.
5. If Glacier is screened on Wednesday, then Fjord is screened on Monday.

rules.note: Glacier on Wednesday (pos 3) OR Thursday (pos 4) — encoded as exactly_one_of with not_at fallback; see conditional rule
